text_ar:
و حَدَّثَنِي عَنْ مَالِك عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ
لَا يَطَأُ الرَّجُلُ وَلِيدَةً إِلَّا وَلِيدَةً إِنْ شَاءَ بَاعَهَا وَإِنْ شَاءَ وَهَبَهَا وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَمْسَكَهَا وَإِنْ شَاءَ صَنَعَ بِهَا مَا شَاءَ
text_ar_search:
و حدثني عن مالك عن نافع عن عبد الله بن عمر أنه كان يقول
لا يطأ الرجل وليدة إلا وليدة إن شاء باعها وإن شاء وهبها وإن شاء أمسكها وإن شاء صنع بها ما شاء
text_en:
Yahya related to me from Malik from Nafi that Abdullah ibn Umar
would say, "A man should not have intercourse with a slave girl except
one whom, if he wished, he could sell, if he wished, he could give
away, if he wished, he could keep, if he wished, he could do with her
what he wanted ."


Malik said that a man who bought a slave-
girl on condition that he did not sell her, give her away, or do
something of that nature, was not to have intercourse with her. That
was because he was not permitted to sell her or to give her away, so
if he did not own that from her, he did not have complete ownership of
her because an exception had been made concerning her by the hand of
someone else. If that sort of condition entered into it, it was a
messy situation, and the sale was not recommended.
text_id: Telah menceritakan kepadaku dari Malik dari [Nafi'] dari [Abdullah bin Umar] ia berkata; "Janganlah seorang lelaki menyetubuhi budak perempuan kecuali budak perempuan yang jika kamu mau, maka kamu bisa menjualnya, atau menahannya, atau menghibahkannya, atau budak yang kamu bisa melakukan apa saja kepadanya."
